MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Display of Aerial Photographs.
Aerial photographs lent by General Headquarters, Far East Command, may be displayed by the War Rehabilitation Bureau, Japanese Government, at the "Reconstruction Exhibitions of Bombed-out Cities."
